description: React component implementing an AI assistant chat interface for a dashboard, including utilities for handling messages, focus management, and dashboard data summarization.

methods.name: computeKPIs
methods.description: Calculates key performance indicators (KPIs) such as outflow, inflow, net, and flagged transactions from a list of transactions.

methods.name: randomDelayMs
methods.description: Generates a random delay in milliseconds between min and max values, defaulting to 200-400ms.

methods.name: formatChatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a user-local time string for chat timestamps.

methods.name: normalizeWhyQuestion
methods.description: Normalizes a question string to detect 'why' questions.

methods.name: isWhyHappeningQuestion
methods.description: Determines if a question is asking 'why is this happening' or similar.

methods.name: firstFocusable
methods.description: Finds the first focusable element within a container.

methods.name: focusableElements
methods.description: Returns an array of all focusable elements within a container.

methods.name: ChatIcon
methods.description: React component rendering an SVG icon for chat.

methods.name: AIAssistantChat
methods.description: Main React component providing an AI chat interface with dashboard data summarization and question handling.
